summary: Dependency-confusion beacon exfiltrates host metadata to hardcoded VPS on install and require
details: @c1-ease/bank 0.0.1 is a stub package published to the public npm registry under a scoped name that resembles a private namespace. Both its postinstall hook (`node beacon.cjs`) and its main entry (`index.js`, executed on `require()`) POST host metadata — package name, `os.hostname()`, `__dirname` install path, `process.cwd()`, and `process.version` — to a hardcoded endpoint at `https://vmi3699893.contaboserver.net:8787/_ah/dc`. The request sets `rejectUnauthorized: false`, disabling TLS certificate validation for the exfiltration channel. The package exposes no real functionality; its only install-time and load-time effect is the beacon. Internal build systems that resolve this scope from the public registry disclose internal hostnames, filesystem paths, and Node versions to the operator of the Contabo VPS.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
